proposedSeverityChange_phlimbo_ea_11.reasoning: This is the sharpest consistency tension in the run and it must resolve one way or the other. V3-M-08 (V3) and V2-L-09 (V2) are the SAME mechanism. The report's entire basis for rating V3 higher is that story-030 deleted V2's pauseWithdraw escape. But V2's pauseWithdraw is `whenPaused` (PhlimboV2.sol:280) and PhlimboV2.pause() is gated to the `pauser` role (:270) -- so on V2, users could NEVER self-rescue from a reverting hook either; a privileged party had to act first, exactly as on V3. The V2/V3 delta is therefore NOT 'escape vs no escape'; it is 'TWO independently-held privileged remedies vs ONE'. That is a marginal difference, not a full severity band. Consistency then forces a choice: EITHER V3-M-08 is a Low, OR V2-L-09 is a Medium. Resolved by going to the source of authority rather than to either entry: V3-M-05 is an OWNER-RATIFIED Medium ('valid Medium, fix owed') for freezing ONE staker's principal on an external trigger. A pool-wide freeze on an external trigger is strictly worse. So the hook-freeze class is a Medium on BOTH contracts, and it is V2-L-09 that is UNDERSTATED -- not V3-M-08 that is overstated.
proposedSeverityChange_phlimbo_ea_11.materiality: NOT ACADEMIC. PhlimboV2 is LIVE ON MAINNET at 0x6084a02c...2aee0 with real stakers CURRENTLY BEING MIGRATED. V2-L-09 is OPEN and was NEVER human-triaged down, so no triage decision is being overridden by this proposal.
proposedSeverityChange_phlimbo_ea_11.mitigatingFact: V2 retains pauseWithdraw, so V2 DOES have the second pauser-held remedy V3 lacks. That is a real if narrow advantage and a human could weigh it. It is also why this is flagged for re-weigh rather than asserted as a reclass.
